name: Saji
source: Teacher, wannabe archaeologist, and surrogate parent to Kokoro. A perpetually languid and worn-out individual. When it comes to things that pique his interest, he engages with an intensity that's unimaginable from his usual demeanor. He does the bare minimum at his teaching job. He often defies orders from above, but he's skilled at covering his tracks, so he's never been found out.
